_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), Series 5LMKN, SET-3, Q.P. Code 30/5/3. 24 page images: idx 0 bilingual cover (announces 23 printed pages; last folio reads 24), idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English General Instructions; English on every even index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 3-21 (each the Hindi of the page after it). Odd pages checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi; idx 17 confirmed at full size (Hindi Q33(b)-36 drawing). Every English page ends on a whole question, so nothing spills onto an odd top; the Q36 drawing sits at the foot of idx 18 and its passage and parts at the top of idx 20. idx 23 (folio 24) is BLANK, confirmed at full size. General Instructions (i)-(x) confirm full80. Instruction (viii) prints 2 internal choices in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 (of 2 marks) in E, but this paper carries only ONE in Section B: the internal choices are Q22, Q26, Q28, Q32, Q33, Q36(iii), Q37(iii), Q38(iii), eight in all, found on the paper and confirmed by walking the marking scheme page by page (a bare OR at exactly these eight and nowhere else; Q21, Q23, Q24 and Q25 carry none). The instruction block appears to be carried over unchanged from 30/5/1, whose Q22 was an OR pair; here that slot is Q21, a single question. Section-A keys read off the marking scheme for 30/5/3 (footer MS_X_Mathematics_041_30/5/3_2025-26) and each re-derived: all 20 agree. No keyless voids. Decimal points are ORDINARY full stops on this paper and in its scheme. Sibling of 30/5/1: 41 rows copied byte for byte from it after reading each on this paper (Q1-4, 6-8, 10-13, 15-17, 19-20, 22-24, 26, 28-30, 32, 34, 36-38), 11 transcribed fresh (Q5, 9, 14, 18, 21, 25, 27, 31, 33(a), 33(b), 35). The case studies print no 'Case Study - N' label, so no _caseStudyLabel.

questions.subtopic: HCF and LCM by Prime Factorisation
questions.context: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled Assertion (A) and the other labelled Reason (R). Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below :
questions.stem:
**Assertion (A) :** H.C.F. \((36m^2, 18m) = 18m\), where m is a prime number.

**Reason (R) :** H.C.F. of two numbers is always less than or equal to the smaller number.

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
